description: This file contains utility functions for accessing and formatting WhatsApp-specific configuration settings within the openclaw project. It includes functions to resolve accounts, process 'allowFrom' entries, and obtain default 'to' values, integrating seamlessly with the OpenClaw configuration structure.

methods.name: export function resolveWhatsAppConfigAllowFrom(params: { resolveWhatsAppConfigAllowFrom
methods.description: Returns an array of allowed 'from' entries for a WhatsApp account based on the provided configuration and optional account ID.

methods.name: export function formatWhatsAppConfigAllowFromEntries(allowFrom: Array<string | number>): string[/ formatWhatsAppConfigAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Normalizes and formats the 'allowFrom' entries into an array of strings.

methods.name: export function resolveWhatsAppConfigDefaultTo(params: { resolveWhatsAppConfigDefaultTo
methods.description: Retrieves and trims the default 'to' value from the account configuration, returning undefined if not set.
